name: Conjure Launcher
description:
A keyboard-first launcher for GNOME Shell: fuzzy search across apps, windows, session actions, a calculator with unit conversion, emoji, recent files, GNOME Settings pages and GNOME search providers. Opens on Super+Space in place of the Show Apps grid.

Clipboard: the launcher copies results you pick to the clipboard, and keeps a history of the text you copy for /clip, in memory only (cleared at logout and screen lock, and never for copies a password manager marks as secret). The history can be turned off in Settings.
